global_pair_result.interpretation: Across the accepted 96-config extension layer, EDOF residuals redistribute through-focus quality rather than providing a free image-quality gain. The single positive MTFa@0D pair is ATC+N0+RAD+EPD5; its through-focus mean remains negative.

n0_referenced_coupling_review.definition: (EDOF-MONO)_postop - (EDOF-MONO)_N0 within the same Base x Platform x Pupil stratum

A0V12.WFS: DOF50 interaction is positive in both base eyes at EPD3 and EPD5; the EPD5 increase is larger than EPD3.
A0V12.RAD: DOF50 interaction is negative in both base eyes at EPD3 and positive in both base eyes at EPD5.
A0V12.HOA: DOF50 interaction is negative in both base eyes at EPD3 and small positive in both base eyes at EPD5.

B0V12.WFS: EPD3 DOF50 interaction is strongly positive in both base eyes but is a lower bound because both postoperative EDOF pairs are far-censored; EPD5 is positive and exact.
B0V12.RAD: EPD5 DOF50 interaction is strongly positive in both base eyes; EPD3 is small and changes sign between base eyes.
B0V12.HOA: EPD3 interaction is near zero and changes sign across base eyes; EPD5 is positive but modest.

C0V12.WFS: EPD3 interaction is near zero and changes sign across base eyes; EPD5 is positive in both base eyes.
C0V12.RAD: EPD5 DOF50 interaction is strongly positive in both base eyes and is a lower bound in both; EPD3 is small and changes sign across base eyes.
C0V12.HOA: EPD3 interaction is negative in both base eyes; EPD5 is strongly positive, with the ATC stratum a lower bound.

n0_referenced_coupling_review.interpretation: The postoperative corneal background changes the magnitude and pupil dependence of the same frozen EDOF mechanisms. The most robust amplification patterns are B0V12-WFS at EPD3 and B0V12-RAD / C0V12-RAD / C0V12-HOA at EPD5. Small sign-discordant interactions are treated as base-dependent near-zero effects, not as stable directional coupling.

scientific_caveats: Five pair-level DOF50 effects are far-censored lower bounds; any N0-referenced interaction containing them must also be reported as a bound rather than an exact width difference.
Ten pair-level distance-peak locations are censored at the frozen search boundary; boundary locations are not exact peak estimates.
Several small N0-referenced DOF50 interactions change sign between LB and ATC base eyes. These near-zero effects should not be promoted to robust directional coupling claims.
The deterministic 2-base-eye matrix is a mechanism study, not a random patient sample; no population-level inferential claim is made.
The frozen focus window is retained. Censoring is part of the result and is not removed by additional OpticStudio acquisition.
